title: Complete source-stated BD 228950 GC agar base composition and correct brand scope
body:
The unapplied W04 BD_228950_GC_Agar_Base.yaml payload is opaque despite TOGO M2206 explicitly listing six dry-base components: NaCl 5 g, KH2PO4 1 g, K2HPO4 4 g, agar 10 g, corn starch 1 g and Proteose Peptone No. 3 15 g (nominal total 36 g). Preparation water, hemoglobin and IsoVitaleX are separate. The captured manufacturer SDS identifies BD Diagnostic Systems, not evidence for the proposal’s narrower Difco brand assertion.

Exact reviewed scope:
- Finding `MEDIA-SCI-02`; stable key `w04-independent-MEDIA-SCI-02`; immutable peer review `20261108T070033Z-w04-successor-science-v1`.
- `media-product-bd_228950_gc_agar_base`; owner `data/ingredients/mapped/BD_228950_GC_Agar_Base.yaml`; before `absent (new proposal; no maintained owner created)`; proposed SHA256 `0372144e888937706c0c71cbca4a4c2ee04a4c3729dab6281f520e1e35a4e6e2`.
  [Exact published proposal](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-04/proposals/media/BD_228950_GC_Agar_Base.yaml).

Represent the six literal source-supported dry-base components and a source-specific component assertion with honest completeness/grounding limits. Preserve unresolved component form instead of borrowing a convenient hydrated or branded owner. Keep water, hemoglobin and IsoVitaleX outside this dry base. Use evidenced BD manufacturer scope unless independent evidence establishes Difco. Preserve exact recipe source, quantities, historical payload and all approval/role/export holds.

Evidence:

- [Primary/ontology source](https://togomedium.org/sparqlist/api/gmdb_medium_by_gmid?gm_id=M2206); capture SHA256 `353f8020959754028cfc23c7bac0095f88114dd9194bf07f84aebbfc6c174044`; components paragraph_index11 GC agar base(BD228950), paragraph9 SolutionA, paragraph13 SolutionB; comments4-6
- [Primary/ontology source](https://imgcdn.mckesson.com/CumulusWeb/Click_and_learn/SDS_BBL_MEDIA_AGAR_GC_MED_BASE_500G.pdf); capture SHA256 `8f1a0987df3db96433a0dbe971ed0dee591c3ca34d65e99d09ce1c6157648cea`; Sections1 ProductIdentifier/Manufacturer,2 selected hazard ingredients,9 powder physical form

Deduplication: Fresh all-state 228950 search found no exact tracker. #1201 is related completeness context; this dedicated new-payload correction has a specific composition and unsupported brand scope.

Review context: W04 published head `548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9`, frozen campaign base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Main as observed at `0dac278466699129a083343a921c2e0ca18a9ab4` has the same eighteen affected inherited-owner blobs as the frozen baseline; this is not a report of already-applied campaign curation. The full independent assembly covers 188 source cases and 115 proposals and remains `needs_curation`. Original peer review and evidence are immutable. Agent-authored new mapping evidence must satisfy #1226 without relabeling historical human evidence. The fix must use existing native guarded proposal validation and independent re-review; it grants no maintained-owner or export approval and requires no new gate, threshold, or synonym-selection rule.
